summary: Superangel is an early-stage fund founded, run and backed by tech entrepreneurs, offering funding in the Baltics and Nordics. Its homepage asks whether a founder is raising a pre-seed or seed round, states a typical ticket of €300,000 to €1,000,000, and names three focus areas: AI and robotics, data and infrastructure, and deep tech and science. Portfolio founder Markus Lember of Montonio is quoted. Startups apply through a submission form. A street address is not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: CEO Markus Lember is quoted on the homepage on Superangel helping the company find first customers. Round and date are not stated.

sources.title: Homepage: stages, ticket size, focus areas, Baltics and Nordics and submission link
